lines.name: l1
lines.text: Everyone laughed when the janitor asked to look at the engine.

lines.name: l2
lines.text: Three engineers had worked on it for six hours. The test was in the morning.

lines.name: l3
lines.text: He listened for ten seconds. Then he tightened one bolt.

lines.name: l4
lines.text: The engine started on the first try.

lines.name: l5
lines.text: Nobody knew he had designed it. Thirty years ago.
